hints.title: Identifying the Bottleneck Project
hints.text: The primary constraint is that no two consecutive weeks may be dedicated to the identical project.

hints.title: Comparing Maximum Project Against the Rest
hints.text: Let S be the sum of all milestones and M be the largest project milestone. The remaining projects provide R = S - M milestone buffers.

hints.title: Saturating Milestone Slots
hints.text: If M exceeds R + 1, we can only work 2 * R + 1 weeks before the bottleneck runs out of buffers; otherwise all S milestones are achievable.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass sum and maximum extraction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating week-by-week work scheduling with a priority queue leads to time limit exceeded when milestones reach 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pigeonhole principle and alternating slot arithmetic determine the capacity in O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only the single largest project can bottleneck alternating execution.
